title: Green peas, canned, cooked, fat added, NS as to fat type

content.title: About
content.content: Canned green peas are cooked pea beans packed in a sealed tin with added vegetable oil. The product is ready to eat, retains a bright green color and a tender texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green peas belong to the legume family and are a good source of plant protein.
Canning allows the peas to be stored for several years without major loss of nutrients.
The added fat enhances flavor and improves absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins.
Peas are used in traditional dishes worldwide, from soups to purees.
Cans are often marked with the NS code, indicating that the type of fat is not specified.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: One cup of canned peas provides about 8 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Peas are high in B1, B6 and folate, which are important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: The combination of plant fats and potassium contributes to normal blood pressure.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phytonutrients in peas help combat free radicals.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Canned foods often contain added salt; people monitoring sodium should check the label.

items.title: Added fat type unknown
items.content: The fat type is not specified (NS), so those with specific fat restrictions should be cautious.

items.title: Bacterial contamination after opening
items.content: Once opened, the product should be refrigerated and consumed within a few days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Peas can be eaten straight from the can, added to salads, soups, stews, or blended into a puree. For extra flavor, toss with herbs, spices, or a splash of lemon juice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cans in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the peas in a sealed container in the refrigerator and use within 3‑4 days.
